sentences.text: Volkswagen AG -LRB- -LSB- ˈfɔlksˌvaːgən -RSB- -RRB- , known internationally as Volkswagen Group , is a German multinational automotive manufacturing company headquartered in Wolfsburg , Lower Saxony , Germany .	AG	Aktiengesellschaft	Volkswagen	Volkswagen	German	Germany	multinational	multinational corporation	automotive	Automotive industry	Wolfsburg	Wolfsburg	Lower Saxony	Lower Saxony	Germany	Germany

It designs , manufactures and distributes passenger and commercial vehicles , motorcycles , engines , and turbomachinery and offers related services including financing , leasing and fleet management .	engines	internal combustion engine	financing	financing	fleet management	fleet management	leasing	leasing
In 2016 , it was the world 's largest automaker , overtaking Toyota , but in 2017 , it is the world 's second largest automaker -LRB- behind Toyota -RRB- .	Toyota	Toyota
It has maintained the largest market share in Europe for over two decades .
It ranked seventh in the 2016 Fortune Global 500 list of the world 's largest companies .	Fortune Global 500	Fortune Global 500

Volkswagen Group sells passenger cars under the Audi , Bentley , Bugatti , Lamborghini , Porsche , SEAT , Škoda and Volkswagen marques ; motorcycles under the Ducati brand ; and commercial vehicles under the marques MAN , Scania , and Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles . Volkswagen was founded in 1937 to manufacture the car which would become known as the Beetle .	Volkswagen	Volkswagen	Beetle	Volkswagen Beetle
The company 's production grew rapidly in the 1950s and 1960s , and in 1965 it acquired Auto Union , which subsequently produced the first post-war Audi models .	Audi	Audi	Auto Union	Auto Union

Volkswagen launched a new generation of front-wheel drive vehicles in the 1970s , including the Passat , Polo and Golf ; the latter became its bestseller .	Volkswagen	Volkswagen	Passat	Volkswagen Passat	Polo	Volkswagen Polo	Golf	Volkswagen Golf

Volkswagen acquired a controlling stake in SEAT in 1986 , making it the first non-German marque of the company , and acquired control of Škoda in 1994 , of Bentley , Lamborghini and Bugatti in 1998 , Scania in 2008 and of Ducati , MAN and Porsche in 2012 . The company 's operations in China have grown rapidly in the past decade with the country becoming its largest market .

Volkswagen Aktiengesellschaft is a public company and has a primary listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange , where it is a constituent of the Euro Stoxx 50 stock market index , and secondary listings on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange , SIX Swiss Exchange .
